categories.calibration_harness: The monitor and explicitly marked read-only preflight or controlled-workload coordinator. Excluded from CPU interference scoring, but retained in raw evidence.
categories.benchmark_model_process: The frozen launcher or model worker that would be part of the measured benchmark. Excluded from external CPU interference scoring, but retained.
categories.required_service_host: A process directly proven by command or ancestry to host a required service, such as Ollama, Qdrant, or the Docker backend hosting Qdrant. Excluded; UI/renderers are not inherited exemptions.
categories.user_browser_workload: A real Chrome or Safari executable. Always triggers the independent browser hard rule and remains visible to CPU scoring.
categories.run_supervision_ui_tooling: ChatGPT or Codex application UI, renderer, or service. Not exempt; persistence policies decide whether its CPU is meaningful.
categories.unrelated_external_workload: Identified user or calibration workload external to required services. Included in CPU scoring.
categories.os_background_service: Identified operating-system background process. Included in CPU scoring.
categories.unknown: Insufficient identity evidence. Included in CPU scoring and reported separately.

process_identity.group_key: category plus canonical executable path plus nearest identified application/service ancestor; PID is retained but is not the stable group identity

candidate_policies.definition: Exact frozen v1 controls(): browser presence or any non-exempt process at or above 50 percent in one sample.

S2_TERMINAL_ONLY_IDLE.chatgpt_codex: closed after deterministic Terminal launch and before sampling

S3_REQUIRED_SERVICE_ACTIVITY.activity: existing read-only repository/freeze, service identity, SEC health, two Qdrant index snapshots, planner import/construction, and 30-second settle; no semantic retrieval or inference

S4_SUSTAINED_CPU_INTERFERENCE.workload: owned deterministic Python busy loop targeting one fully occupied CPU core; expected observed process CPU 80-120 percent

S5_SHORT_CPU_BURSTS.workload: owned deterministic Python busy loop targeting one fully occupied CPU core

S6_BROWSER_WORKLOAD.workload: owned real Google Chrome headless process with an isolated temporary profile and local CPU-active data page; no network dependency

clean_environment.interpretation_limit: Passing establishes calibration-window practicality, not an hour-scale statistical upper bound.

selection_rule.rule: A candidate must pass every pre-registered criterion. If multiple pass, choose the first in the preference order, which favors the simplest and most sensitive same-process persistence rule. If none pass, return CONTROL_V2_NOT_VALIDATED. No post-result compromise or new candidate is allowed in calibration version 1.

historical_replay.inputs: PR32 observation plus all prior invalid-diagnostic process observations
